officialText:
Article 394 Part II – After subheading “Part II. Installation” of the Article, add a sentence to read as follows and delete remainder of the Article.

Part II. Installation

394.12 Uses Not Permitted. Installation of Concealed Knob-and-Tube Wiring shall not be permitted.
